{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:08.500
    | text      = So, uh, we start off with Tim Pool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:12.820

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:13.820
    | text      = Uh, talking about the wave of Islamic terrorism that's going on in the United States.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.659
    | text      = Buh buh buh buh buh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:20.299
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:21.299
    | text      = Today we saw two attacks and we know one of them was a man who yelled Aluhu Akbar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:27.179
    | text      = The other attack on a synagogue, it is suspected to be Islamic terror.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:31.059
    | text      = So the rumors going around are that we had two Islamic terror attacks, possibly retaliation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:36.740
    | text      = over the war in Iran, which we had seen another terror attack in New York City, the throwing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:42.299
    | text      = of an improvised explosive device as well as the attack in Austin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:46.299
    | text      = So of course the expectation is, well, we don't have the complete information, the synagogue
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:49.919
    | text      = attack.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.919
    | text      = It was a vehicle reportedly owned by a man from Lebanon who was naturalized and lived
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:55.480
    | text      = in Dearborn, Michigan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:56.500
    | text      = So many people are saying, hey, that, you know, if it looks and sounds like a duck.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:00.100
    | text      = I feel like Tim likes to present himself as someone who's above the, if it looks like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:04.019
    | text      = a duck level of reasoning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:05.700
    | text      = A lot of animals who aren't ducks look like ducks, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:10.460
    | text      = The temple attack that he's talking about in Michigan appears to have been carried out
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.259
    | text      = by a guy who has family in Lebanon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.759
    | text      = The perpetrator died in the attack, thankfully the only casualty of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:19.279
    | text      = So we may never know exactly why he did it, but there are some indications that he had
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:23.679
    | text      = family members in Hezbollah who were killed in Israel's recent strikes on Lebanon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:28.799
    | text      = It would be somewhat inaccurate to say that this is the same thing as his attack being
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.519
    | text      = inspired by Trump's attack on Iran, but at the same time there's good reason to believe
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:37.919
    | text      = many of these actions are happening in the shared context of a larger war.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:42.559
    | text      = So while I don't agree with the way that Tim's framing this, someone else might be able to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.600
    | text      = make a better argument using similar pieces.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.360
    | text      = I was wondering about that, is it a terror attack?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.039
    | text      = That's a really interesting kind of distinction to make in the context that we're in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.159
    | text      = Is it a terrorist or is it like a just response?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
